data.case_title: Payment reminder from Beispiel Versand GmbH
data.explanation: Beispiel Versand GmbH, an online shop, says they haven't received payment for your order of 02.04.2026 and asks you to transfer EUR 64.98 to their account by the date shown. This is only a friendly reminder (Zahlungserinnerung), not a formal legal dunning notice, and no fees or legal steps are mentioned. If you already paid, the letter says you can disregard it. Otherwise, pay promptly using the IBAN and reference details given, or contact the sender if you dispute the amount. Keep an eye out in case further reminders with added fees follow.
